# Inherited pkg installer fixtures

These scripts exercise the inherited pkg engine's onboarding behavior. They
are test assets and are not shipped or served by the common APKG portal.
`tests/installer-onboarding.py` runs the shell installer with synthetic homes,
commands and network responses.

Source: `pomaros/apkg-fusion` revision
`ac471fb7b74026302c6a0f7567401642d208689d`, formerly
`portal/src/Portal/Install/`. Original notices are retained.
